This '''ship''' was a [[Heraklon-class transport|''Heraklon''-class transport]] utilized by the [[Zhug brothers]], a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] group active during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Dark Wars]]. In [[3951 BBY]], they took a job to collect the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on a former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], [[Meetra Surik]], set by the [[Exchange]] crime organization. As the Zhugs were chasing her with their [[Starship/Legends|ship]] on her way to [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], both Surik and the bounty hunters were [[Blockade of Onderon|forced]] to land on Onderon's [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]], after taking damage from a [[Blockade/Legends|blockading]] [[Onderon separatists|Onderon separatist]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The ship was destroyed in the crash-landing and its crew was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Surik and her companions soon afterward.

==Description==
This [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was a [[Heraklon-class transport|''Heraklon''-class]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]]-type [[Transport/Legends|transport]] starship, a model manufactured by [[Sadon Shipwrights]] that saw a wide use in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] surrounding the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="message" />

==History==
Sometime prior to the end of the [[Dark Wars]], a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] group, the [[Zhug brothers]], obtained this ''Heraklon''-class ship.<ref name="kotor2" /> In [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="message" /> [[G0-T0]], a local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] of the [[Exchange]] crime organization in the [[Y'Toub system/Legends|Y'Toub system]], set a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on a former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]<ref name="kotor2" /> [[Meetra Surik]],<ref name="revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> known as the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|Exile]]. The Zhugs took the job to collect the bounty.<ref name="kotor2" />

{{K2order}}
[[File:Zhugship3-crop.png|thumb|left|250px|The Zhug Ship and its surviving crew after crash-landing in the jungles of Dxun moon]]
When Surik arrived on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in order to find the source of the bounty on her head, the Zhug brothers made [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (First Jedi Purge)|two attempts]] to claim the bounty. Their failure in both attempts resulted in the [[Death/Legends|loss]] of [[Azanti Zhug]], one of their leaders. After the attacks, they pursued the Jedi's small [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]'', with their ship on her way off the moon.<ref name="kotor2" />

When the ''Ebon Hawk'' and the Zhug brothers' ship eventually arrived in the [[Japrael system/Legends|Onderon system]], both ships encountered an [[Onderon separatists]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] that was holding Republic [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] ships and the securing [[Republic Navy/Legends|military fleet]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], prohibiting them from entering the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]].<ref name="message" /> Soon after, following the order of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Tobin (Human)|Tobin]], the separatist [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] opened fire on the blockaded Republic ships in the opening of the [[Blockade of Onderon|first battle]] of the [[Onderon Civil War]]. The Zhugs' ship took its share of fire, and the inflicted damage caused the ship to fall from the sky while screaming its ID signature, crash-landing in the jungles of Onderon's moon [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]]. Two Zhug brothers, following Zhug leader [[Dezanti Zhug]], survived the crash-landing that wrecked their ship, while Surik's freighter landed nearby. Soon, the Zhugs encountered Surik and her companions, but they failed in claiming the bounty on the former Jedi Knight&mdash;their attack on her resulted in the death of the Zhug trio by the Exile and her companions.<ref name="kotor2" />
{{Endgame}}

As a result of the destruction of the Zhug Ship, sales of ''Heraklon''-class transports decreased due to its damaged reputation. Eventually, a change in the model's marketing to focus on the vessel's safety in case of an accident returned sales to a profitable level, ensuring the continuation of production.<ref name="message" />

==Commanders and crew==
During the ship's pursuit of Meetra Surik and its destruction on Dxun, the vessel was operated by three Zhug brothers, including the leader, Dezanti Zhug.<ref name="kotor2" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:IfYouSquintYouCanSeeStarships-KOTOR2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|''Heraklon''-class transport ships&mdash;the same class as the Zhug Ship&mdash;in the blockade of Onderon]]
The Zhug Ship was first introduced in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[Obsidian Entertainment]] at the end of [[2004]]. In the game, the player controlling the Jedi Exile is allowed to visit several planets after leaving [[Telos IV]].<ref name="kotor2" /> This article assumes that the Jedi Exile visits Nar Shaddaa before traveling to Onderon's moon Dxun, as presented in the game's [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords: Prima Official Game Guide|''Prima Official Game Guide'']].<ref name="kotorcg">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Several ships of the same class were briefly seen in the cutscene when arriving on Onderon, waiting in the planet's blockade. Soon after, the Zhugs' ship is found as wreckage on the surface of Dxun.<ref name="kotor2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> Although the game doesn't name the ship formally, the game model is labeled as "Zhug Ship" in the game dialogue file.<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' dialogue file, StrRef 87291</ref>

The Zhug Ship received its class alongside the technical description and history of the model in "[[Message to Spacers]] 9", an article written by [[Patrick Stutzman]] and released in [[2010]] as an online supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. The article also contained details of the events that led to the Zhug brothers crash-landing on Dxun, identifying that the damage had been caused by Onderon separatist forces under Colonel Tobin's command.<ref name="message" />
